# Tripo

> > Tripo is an AI-powered 3D generation platform that converts text prompts and images into production-ready 3D models with advanced editing, texturing, rigging, and export capabilities.

Tripo provides a comprehensive suite of AI tools for 3D model creation, including text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation, intelligent segmentation, PBR texturing, auto-rigging, and stylization. The platform supports multiple export formats (OBJ, FBX, STL) and integrates with industry-standard software like Blender, Maya, and Unity, making it suitable for game development, animation, and professional 3D workflows.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-3D generation

## Core Platform

- [Tripo Homepage](https://www.tripo3d.ai): Main landing page: AI 3D model generator for text/image to 3D conversion
- [Tripo Studio Workspace](https://studio.tripo3d.ai): Complete AI-powered 3D workspace with generation and editing tools
- [Studio Home](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/home): Tripo Studio main interface for AI-powered 3D generation and editing
- [Workspace Overview](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/overview): 3D generation workspace overview with editing tools and project management
- [Generation Interface](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/generate): Create 3D models with AI from text prompts and image inputs

## 3D Generation Features

- [Text-to-3D Model](https://www.tripo3d.ai/features/text-to-3d-model): Convert text prompts to production-ready 3D models in seconds
- [Image-to-3D Model](https://www.tripo3d.ai/features/image-to-3d-model): Generate 3D models from single or multi-view images instantly
- [AI Model Segmentation](https://www.tripo3d.ai/features/ai-model-segmentation): Split 3D models into editable parts with intelligent one-click segmentation
- [AI Texturing](https://www.tripo3d.ai/features/ai-texturing): Auto-texture 3D models with PBR materials for production-quality results
- [Auto-Rigging](https://www.tripo3d.ai/features/ai-auto-rigging): AI-powered skeleton detection and automatic skin weight assignment for animation
- [Model Stylization](https://www.tripo3d.ai/features/ai-model-stylization): Transform 3D models into artistic styles like Lego, Voxel, and Voronoi
